dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good afternoon, Nam. What's the matter?
dialogue.reading: ɡʊd ˌæftərˈnuːn, ˈnɑːm. ˈwʌts ðə ˈmætər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I feel dizzy, Doctor. And I feel very weak.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈfiːl ˈdɪzi, ˈdɑːktər. ənd aɪ ˈfiːl ˈvɛri ˈwiːk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, sometimes. And I can't eat.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈsʌmtaɪmz. ənd aɪ ˈkænt ˈiːt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No. But my arms and legs are itchy.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ. bʌt maɪ ˈɑːrmz ənd ˈlɛɡz ər ˈɪtʃi.
